message.content: Even if the runtime supports local inference, there might still be limitations that prevent its widespread use. For instance, the organization which creates and distributes the model must still determine the means and purposes of processing. This means that even if the personal data involved in training is being processed on the users device, the organization which creates and distributes the model is still a controller in so far as it determines the means and purposes of processing.
